experiences.title: Chrome Extension for Appointment Reminders (Freelance)
description: Developed a Chrome extension to send WhatsApp appointment reminders by integrating Google Calendar with WhatsApp Business API
Designed a pop-up for users to review and confirm messages before sending, based on pre-created templates.
Significantly reduced staff time managing reminders, streamlining communication and improving scheduling efficiency, while boosting the company's image with automation
Took a 6-month break to travel around the world in a group of 200 professionals, gaining valuable experiences that enhanced my communication skills and fostered cross-cultural collaboration

experiences.title: Full Stack Software Engineer in HCM Integrations
description: Developed and maintained integrations connecting our platform with Human Capital Management (HCM) systems.
Contributed to transitioning a monolithic legacy application (Java) to a scalable microservices architecture (Node.js).
Supported the migration of services to a serverless, event-driven architecture, reducing operational overhead by 20%.
Created a reusable integration framework, streamlining processes and cutting development time by 30%.
Improved observability by implementing dashboards and metrics with New Relic (service metrics), Heap (ux metrics), and Tableau (BI metrics), achieving 45% faster incident response times.
Contributed to Data Warehouse to Data Lake migration, collaborating with DevOps, Data Engineering, and Data Analytics teams to create effective dashboards.

experiences.title: Blockchain-Based Traceability Web Application (Freelance)
description: Developed RiceChain, a web-based platform to enhance traceability, transparency, and data immutability across production processes (e.g., rice) as part of my engineering thesis.

experiences.title: Tailored app for a lighting factory (Freelance)
description: Developed a tailored program to manage orders, control stock, and enhance coordination between departments, including features for identifying missing stock items for pending orders and generating data for lighting fixture manufacturing.
Expanded the system's functionality to include statistical analysis tools, optimizing sales and improving decision-making processes.
